methodology.isolation: fresh process per worker count; fixed pool reused across sizes
methodology.timing: input partitioning and required dedicated-buffer copies, dispatch, execution, result transport and assembly included; input generation and validation excluded
methodology.memory: process-wide RSS sampled every 5ms plus endpoints; may miss brief peaks
methodology.cpu: process.cpuUsage delta divided by wall time; 100% is one logical CPU, normalized percentage divides by availableParallelism
methodology.cold: startup measured once per configuration; first execution recorded separately for every size; only the first size follows a fresh startup
methodology.repetitions: every raw sample retained; medians used for speedup; no GC forcing or outlier removal
